definition: the joint between the forearm and upper arm
description: In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

taps.target: the man in the blue shirt
